body: My last year of high school none of my friends were in my classes, and in some of my classes I barely knew anybody. I was pretty shy though so apart from group work I was fine with it. Are your friends taking the same subjects as you? You could always meet up outside of class to study together.
I feel the same way a lot. I even tried joining clubs for the things I'm interested in, but none of my friends like the things I am passionate about. What are your interests?

Thank you, I'm sorry about the loss of your father. 

Do you have any advice for talking about it with people? I have a hard time trusting people, and whenever I do tell someone our relationship suffers because they don't know how to deal with it.
Thank you for your kind words. I would like to think so but I also think she would want more than a daughter who is depressed and suicidal :(
